scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && pnpm -r build && node scripts/copy-package-assets.mjs
scripts.quality:a11y: pnpm quality:build && playwright test --config playwright.quality.config.ts --grep accessibility
scripts.quality:keyboard: pnpm quality:build && playwright test --config playwright.quality.config.ts --grep "keyboard|tab order"
scripts.quality:visual: pnpm quality:build && playwright test --config playwright.quality.config.ts --grep "visual baseline|narrow viewport"
scripts.quality: pnpm check:css-scope && pnpm build && pnpm check:size && pnpm quality:browser
scripts.verify: pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm check:css-scope && pnpm check:security && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:size && pnpm verify:node && pnpm verify:packages
